{{Top|leg}}
The '''Stoic missile sentry''' was a missile platform [[Drone/Legends|drone]] produced by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] during the [[Galactic War]] that could be carried as a payload by [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. The Stoic sentry was immobile, armed with a standard [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and a long-range [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]], and was programmed to attack enemy targets within range.
